en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing a large Gothic Roman Catholic church with a tall central spire and clock tower, fronted by a landscaped square with paths, garden beds, a fountain or monument, and horse-drawn carriages and pedestrians. Printed caption text appears below the image in Romanian and Hungarian, mentioning Cluj and the Roman Catholic Saint Michael church.
